Method of Attack: Used as components to build malicious tools including a stager and post-exploitation agents
Agents used for post-exploitation with plugin support to harvest credentials
Impacted Systems: Microsoft Windows systems running Microsoft Office
Attack Vector: Trojanized Word documents exploiting CVE-2017-11882 memory corruption vulnerability
Trojanized Word documents requiring macro enablement to launch Visual Basic scripts
Use of signed MSBuild binary to bypass application whitelisting and launch obfuscated XML stager
Indicators of Compromise: RC4 byte stream encrypted communication channels with C2 server
GET requests with predefined fields such as non-existent user-agent string, session cookie, and specific directory on domain
